cerez.01: This Cookie Policy explains the cookies and similar technologies used on the {{marka}} website, their purposes and how you can manage them.
cerez.03: Cookies are small text files saved to your browser by the websites you visit. They are used to make the site work, remember your preferences and improve the experience.
cerez.05: <kalin>Essential cookies:</kalin> Required for the site’s basic functions, security and session management. The site does not work properly without these cookies. Sign-in and authentication are managed through the Supabase infrastructure.
cerez.06: <kalin>Functional cookies:</kalin> Personalise your experience by remembering your preferences such as language and theme.
cerez.07: <kalin>Analytics cookies:</kalin> Help us improve the site’s performance and content by measuring visitor interaction anonymously/statistically. (When used.)
cerez.09: When you sign in to your account, authentication cookies/storage are used so that your session can be maintained securely. This is an essential function that spares you from signing in again on every page.
cerez.11: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings, or choose to be warned before a cookie is placed. Blocking essential cookies may cause some parts of the site (e.g. sign-in/session) not to work properly. In most browsers, cookie management can be done from the "Settings > Privacy/Security" section.
cerez.13: This policy may be updated from time to time. For your questions: {{eposta}}.

iptal.01: This document explains the withdrawal, cancellation and refund conditions for the {{marka}} subscription in accordance with Law No. 6502 and the Distance Contracts Regulation.
iptal.03: As a rule, the consumer may withdraw from the contract within {{gun}} (fourteen) days from the date performance of the service started, without giving any reason and without paying any penalty. The withdrawal notice may be given in writing to {{eposta}}.
iptal.05: The {{marka}} subscription is a digital (intangible) service performed instantly in an electronic environment. Under Article 15 of the Distance Contracts Regulation, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised if performance of the service begins with the consumer’s express approval before the withdrawal period expires. When the consumer requests immediate performance of the service while confirming the order, they are deemed to have accepted this exception.
iptal.07: The subscription can be cancelled at any time from your account settings or by notice to {{eposta}}.
iptal.08: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period (for which the fee has been collected); access to the service continues until the end of this period and the next automatic renewal is stopped.
iptal.09: After cancellation, as a rule, no separate refund is made for the current period (see Article 4).
iptal.11: Where the right of withdrawal is validly exercised or where the Seller deems it appropriate, the refund is made to the payment instrument through which the collection was made (credit/debit card). Refund transactions are carried out through the iyzico payment infrastructure. The refund amount is initiated within fourteen (14) days from acceptance of the withdrawal/refund request; the time for the amount to appear in the card account depends on the operation of the relevant bank/payment institution.
iptal.13: For your cancellation, refund and withdrawal requests: {{eposta}}{{telefon}}.

kvkk.01: This Privacy Notice has been prepared to inform you, as the data controller, about the processing of your personal data within the scope of Article 10 of Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK").
kvkk.04: Identity data: full name, Turkish ID number (for invoice/payment).
kvkk.06: Customer/transaction data: subscription level, order and payment records, invoice details.
kvkk.07: Account data: user account, sign-in session and authentication information.
kvkk.08: Transaction security data: IP address, log records, cookie data.
kvkk.09: Note: Clinical/patient data is, as a rule, kept encrypted on the user’s device; such data is processed only to the extent required by the service and within the framework of the relevant agreement/privacy notice.
kvkk.11: Establishing and performing the subscription agreement and providing the service.
kvkk.12: Fulfilling the software download request and sending version/update notifications.
kvkk.13: Carrying out payment, invoicing and accounting processes.
kvkk.14: Managing customer support, requests and complaints.
kvkk.15: Account security, fraud prevention and system security.
kvkk.18: Processing data is necessary for establishing/performing a contract.
kvkk.19: The data controller’s fulfilment of its legal obligation.
kvkk.20: Processing is mandatory for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right.
kvkk.21: The legitimate interests of the data controller (provided that fundamental rights and freedoms are not harmed).
kvkk.24: Your personal data may be transferred, for the purpose of providing the service, to the payment institution (iyzico), the infrastructure/hosting service provider (Supabase) and, where necessary, to authorised public bodies and institutions and legally authorised private persons, in accordance with the conditions in Articles 8 and 9 of the KVKK.
kvkk.26: The following data is processed on the infrastructure of service providers <kalin>established abroad</kalin> in order for the service to be provided technically:
kvkk.27: <kalin>Account and authentication data</kalin> — email address, irreversible hash of the password, session tokens, full name/clinic/institution details given during registration. Recipient: <kalin>Supabase</kalin> (authentication and database service).
kvkk.28: <kalin>Device registry data</kalin> — device ID and name, remote access address, local IP address and port, pairing code, last seen time, installed software versions, whether data encryption on the device is on, and a device-specific verification key so that only that device can update the record. This record is updated <kalin>about every 60 seconds</kalin> so that the mobile app can connect to the clinic’s device and so that it can be tracked which devices a security update has reached. Recipient: <kalin>Supabase</kalin>.
kvkk.29: <kalin>Site usage and connection data</kalin> — IP address and request logs. Recipient: <kalin>Vercel</kalin> (website hosting).
kvkk.30: <kalin>Patient and session records (clinical data) are not transferred abroad.</kalin> This data is kept encrypted on the clinic’s own device. The software keeps the synchronisation of clinical data to the cloud <kalin>off by default</kalin>; this setting takes effect only if the clinic explicitly enables it, and even then personal data fields are sent encrypted.
kvkk.31: Payment transactions are carried out through <kalin>iyzico</kalin> (a payment institution established in Türkiye); card data is not stored by us.
kvkk.32: The transfer abroad is made on the basis of the conditions provided for in Article 9 of the KVKK. You may send your request for information about the scope, recipients and basis of the transfer to {{kvkkEposta}}.
kvkk.34: Your personal data is retained for the period required by the purpose of processing and for the periods stipulated in the relevant legislation (e.g. statutory periods for commercial and tax records); at the end of these periods it is deleted, destroyed or anonymised.
kvkk.35: <kalin>Concrete periods applied by the software for treatment records on the clinic device</kalin> (the software’s defaults):
kvkk.36: Sensor measurements recorded during a session (coil temperature, magnetic field, current): <kalin>90 days</kalin>.
kvkk.37: Applied dose records (which coil, at which frequency and ratio, for how long it ran): <kalin>3650 days (10 years)</kalin>.
kvkk.38: Session event records (start, end and similar): <kalin>365 days</kalin>. Emergency stop records (together with their cause: overcurrent, communication rejection, loss of the board connection and similar), the reset of the emergency stop latch, the veterinarian’s approval or rejection of an AI suggestion and the service shutdown that interrupted a session are kept <kalin>INDEFINITELY</kalin>. The deletion of expired events is written to the audit trail together with the number of records deleted.
kvkk.39: Patient identity details: the name, owner’s name, contact details, age and weight of a patient with no treatment record for <kalin>1825 days (5 years)</kalin> — including their name in session and AI analysis records — are anonymised; because this action cannot be undone, it <kalin>does not start without the clinic’s explicit approval</kalin> (Settings → Data Retention Period, the number of waiting patients is shown). Treatment data (applied dose, duration, sensor measurements), species/breed information and the name of the veterinarian who applied the treatment remain.
kvkk.40: Masking of names in session records is <kalin>OFF by default</kalin> and does not start without the clinic’s explicit approval. If the clinic approves, patient and operator names and free-text notes in session records older than the selected period (default <kalin>365 days</kalin>) are irreversibly masked: the text <kod>[REDACTED]</kod> appears in place of the name in the record. Treatment data is not masked. The approval is valid only for the period for which it was given: if the period is changed the approval lapses, and <kalin>re-approval</kalin> is requested by showing the number of records that will be affected by the new period.
kvkk.41: The masking period can be changed by the clinic from within the app (Settings → Data Retention Period) or turned off completely; since the medical and legal retention obligation varies by country and case, the decision belongs to the clinic as the data controller.
kvkk.42: 7. Rights of the Data Subject (KVKK Art. 11)
kvkk.43: To learn whether your personal data is being processed and, if so, to request information about it.
kvkk.44: To learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in line with that purpose.
kvkk.45: To know the third parties to whom it is transferred in Türkiye or abroad.
kvkk.46: To request correction if it is processed incompletely or incorrectly.
kvkk.47: To request deletion or destruction under the conditions provided for in the KVKK.
kvkk.48: To request that corrections and deletions be notified to the third parties to whom the data has been transferred.
kvkk.49: To object to an unfavourable result arising from analysis by automated systems.
kvkk.50: To request compensation for damages if you suffer harm due to unlawful processing.
kvkk.52: You may send your requests within the scope of Article 11 of the KVKK, together with information verifying your identity, to {{kvkkEposta}} or apply in writing to {{adres}}, {{sehir}}. Your applications are concluded within the periods provided for in the KVKK.

mesafeli.01: This Distance Sales Agreement ("Agreement") has been concluded electronically between the Seller, whose identity and contact details are given below, and the Buyer, in accordance with Law No. 6502 on Consumer Protection and the Distance Contracts Regulation. By confirming their order, the Buyer declares that they have read, understood and accepted all the terms of this Agreement.
mesafeli.05: The consumer ("BUYER") on the basis of the full name, address, email and contact details declared in the membership/invoice form during the order. This information appears in the order summary and in the invoice details.
mesafeli.07: The subject of this Agreement is the determination, in accordance with Law No. 6502 and the Distance Contracts Regulation, of the rights and obligations of the parties regarding the sale and performance of the digital software service/subscription, whose features and sale price are specified below, that the BUYER orders electronically via the {{marka}} website of the Seller.
mesafeli.08: ARTICLE 3 — PRODUCT/SERVICE SUBJECT TO THE AGREEMENT
mesafeli.09: The subject of the Agreement is the digital service of the {{marka}} veterinary clinic support software, offered over the internet on a term (monthly/yearly) subscription basis. Depending on the selected subscription level, the service covers the software licence, AI analysis/diagnosis modules, automatic updates and support services. The main features of the service, the scope of the level and the current price are shown at the time of the order on the pricing and order summary pages of the website.
mesafeli.10: The service does not involve the delivery of a physical good; it is performed electronically as an intangible (digital) service.
mesafeli.12: The total price of the service, including all taxes (VAT), is the amount clearly shown to the BUYER in the order summary.
mesafeli.13: Payment is collected securely by credit/debit card through the infrastructure of the payment institution iyzico. Card details are not stored by the Seller; during the payment process they are transferred to iyzico’s secure environment.
mesafeli.14: The subscription is collected in advance according to the selected period (monthly/yearly) and is renewed automatically for the same period unless the BUYER cancels (see Article 6 and the Pre-Contract Information Form).
mesafeli.15: If the payment cannot be made or is cancelled for any reason, the Seller reserves the right to suspend the service or terminate the Agreement.
mesafeli.17: After the payment is approved, the service is assigned to the BUYER’s account electronically and, as a rule, instantly. The performance period cannot exceed the statutory maximum of thirty (30) days. The BUYER is responsible for providing the internet connection and the compatible device/operating system conditions required to access the service.
mesafeli.18: ARTICLE 6 — RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL AND ITS EXCEPTION
mesafeli.19: As a rule, the BUYER has the right to withdraw from the Agreement within {{gun}} (fourteen) days from the start of performance of the service, without giving any reason and without paying any penalty.
mesafeli.20: <kalin>Exception:</kalin> Under Article 15 of the Distance Contracts Regulation, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised in contracts for services performed instantly in an electronic environment, for intangible goods delivered instantly to the consumer, and for services whose performance begins with the consumer’s approval. Accordingly, if performance of the software service/subscription begins with the BUYER’s express approval before the withdrawal period expires, the BUYER loses the right of withdrawal. By confirming the order, the BUYER declares that they expressly request and accept that performance of the service begins within the withdrawal period.
mesafeli.21: In cases where the right of withdrawal applies, the BUYER may exercise it by giving written notice to {{eposta}}; in that case the amount collected is refunded to the same payment instrument within fourteen (14) days from the receipt of the withdrawal notice.
mesafeli.23: The BUYER agrees to use the service in accordance with the law and the Terms of Use. The software is a clinical support tool used under the supervision of a veterinarian and does not replace the veterinarian’s medical decision, diagnosis and treatment.
mesafeli.24: The Seller cannot be held responsible for performance in cases of force majeure, disruptions originating from service providers, or situations arising from the BUYER’s failure to meet the conditions.
mesafeli.25: The BUYER’s personal data is processed within the framework of the KVKK Privacy Notice and the Privacy Policy.
mesafeli.27: In disputes that may arise from this Agreement, the Consumer Arbitration Committees at the BUYER’s place of residence or at the place where the transaction was made are competent within the monetary limits announced by the Ministry of Trade; for disputes above these limits, the Consumer Courts are competent.
mesafeli.29: This Agreement enters into force when it is read and accepted by the BUYER electronically, the order is confirmed and the payment is completed. A copy of the Agreement is made available to the BUYER and/or sent by email.
